# ImGui Bundle library

This is a little library that bundles [Imgui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui) and [Dear Bindings](https://github.com/dearimgui/dear_bindings)
into single package that can be imported by any Cmake project.

**ImGui version**: v1.93.0-docking (tag, commit b916186e66aa3c02b72c6ca17455516512ed8049)
**Dear Bindings version**: v0.27 (release artifact `DearBindings_v0.27_ImGui_v1.93.0.zip`, commit 67ede4170679575167aee8c29a5c68931d112d3f)
